_comment: Channels whose uploads get walked for player cut-ups.
Every channel_id below was RESOLVED AND VERIFIED on 2026-09-21, either
from the refresh job's own resolution log (run 35601948180) or by reading
the channel page directly. Carrying the id means the script derives the
uploads playlist (UC.. -> UU..) and skips a channels.list call per run.
Each channel's recent uploads were inspected via its public RSS feed
before enabling or disabling it. The notes record what was actually seen,
so nobody has to re-litigate the decision later.
Set enabled:false to mute a channel without losing its verified id.

channels.name: STACKED Fantasy | Film Breakdowns
channels.notes: The channel the owner named after we missed 'CeeDee Lamb: Every Touch of 2026 Week 1 | Full Film Compilation'. RSS verified 2026-09-21: the feed title is exactly 'STACKED Fantasy | Film Breakdowns' and ALL 15 recent uploads are single-player cut-ups published 2026-09-21, e.g. 'Derrick Henry: Every Touch of 2026 Week 2 | Full Film Compilation', 'Lamar Jackson: Every Dropback of 2026 Week 2 | Full Film Compilation', 'Chris Olave: Every Touch of 2026 Week 2 | Full Film Compilation'. Every title leads with the player and carries an explicit cut-up phrase, which is the best possible shape for our matcher. NOTE: the 15-entry RSS window only reaches back to week 2, so the owner's specific week-1 Lamb video could NOT be confirmed from RSS - but the title template matches his quote exactly. Coverage for QBs is why 'every dropback' was added to _CUTUP_STRONG_MARKERS.

channels.name: STACKED Fantasy
channels.notes: DISABLED on evidence, and this one is worth reading before anyone re-enables it. It is the sister channel of the film account above and resolves fine, but RSS on 2026-09-21 shows it posts ADP/draft-capital talk, not film: 'Bryce Young is going around pick 172, QB27, and the three year table only moves one way', 'T.J. Hockenson is going at pick 159, the 27th tight end off the board', 'Where are the points in Week 2? Vegas implied totals for all 32 offenses'. That shape is ACTIVELY DANGEROUS to the index rather than merely useless: each title names a tracked player, contains no recap/meme/podcast phrasing, and would therefore have been classified as that player's cut-up and shown in his reel. Enabling it would have injected ADP commentary into the film feed. The matcher was hardened against the shape too ('going around pick', 'going at pick', 'off the board', 'implied totals' are now _NON_GAME_MARKERS), so this is defended in two places. It is also near-dormant: 14 of 15 recent uploads predate 2026-09-04.

channels.name: Curtain Call Replays
channels.notes: The per-player cut-up source this feature was designed around. 15/15 recent uploads matched cut-up phrasing, e.g. 'Amon-Ra St. Brown Week 2 Highlights vs Bills | Every Target and Catch', 'Jahmyr Gibbs Week 1 Highlights vs Saints | Every Play'. Posts daily through the season, full-length rather than Shorts. Verified 2026-09-21.

channels.name: NFL
channels.notes: Official. Best source of full game recaps (team_game fallback) plus 'best plays from' player cut-ups. Caveat: posts a very high volume of Shorts - 52 of the 80 videos in the first real index came from here and were under 75s. The MIN_CLIP_SECONDS filter in highlights.py exists largely because of this channel. Verified 2026-09-21.

channels.name: NFL Films
channels.notes: DISABLED on evidence, not suspicion. Resolves fine and returned 6 uploads in the first real run, but the content is documentary/feature work - 'The Art of The Challenge Flag', 'Like Father, Like Son: The Lake Family Story', 'NFL Sounds of the Summer'. No per-game player cut-ups, so it contributed nothing to the index while costing quota. Verified 2026-09-21.

channels.name: NFL Fantasy Football
channels.notes: DISABLED on evidence. Official and fantasy-relevant, but the uploads are advice and Shorts - 'Starts and Sits for Week 2', 'Top Week 2 Waiver Wire Adds!', '3 Must start running backs'. Those titles hit _NON_GAME_MARKERS and would be rejected anyway, so enabling it only burns quota. Kept here with its verified id so the decision is documented rather than rediscovered. Verified 2026-09-21.

_removed: @FantasyFilmRoom - REMOVED 2026-09-21. It does not resolve; the channel does not exist. It shipped as an 'UNVERIFIED placeholder' and would have failed silently on every run forever.

Utree - investigated after a Reddit recommendation and NOT added: @utree resolves to an unrelated channel ('Shingo Kinoshita'). The correct handle could not be established, so it was left out rather than guessed.
